title: Implement physical-action Safety decision and pending proposal routing

gates.name: safety_aggregate_regression
gates.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/backend/plant_operations tests/backend/agent_runtime tests/backend/agent_chat tests/backend/hydroponics_advisor tests/backend/safety_gate -m "not real_model" -q

evidence_required: Focused PostgreSQL Safety action and migration/model test results.
Role, freshness, expiry, unsupported-action, and archive-race matrix evidence.
Atomic decision/UI duplicate/conflict and rollback evidence.
Feed response evidence showing strict project-owned safety_status data, no candidate text, and both agent flags false.
Regression evidence that existing FT-004, FT-007, FT-008, and FT-010 contracts remain valid.
purpose: Route persisted project-owned classifications through current authorization, exact physical-action support, two-hour approval evidence, and immutable Safety decision/UI projection boundaries without entering FT-012 human-decision state.
success_outcome: Every persisted class selects only its allowed guarded route; supported human ph_adjustment, ec_adjustment, or solution_change reaches immutable pending_human_approval only for a current authorized approver with both pH and EC fresh within 2 hours, unsupported/unauthorized/stale cases produce the exact non-imperative blocked or evidence-needed decision/UI status, retries and archive races fail safely, and no raw candidate, approval, action_task, Timeline/Bus physical text, device command, or automated effect is created.
anti_goals: Do not implement FT-012 approve/reject HTTP, Approval, action_task, completion, follow-up, or outcome records.
Do not add a new FT-011 public endpoint, frontend component, Timeline event, physical-action Bus payload, or automated actuator integration.
Do not calculate target pH/EC, quantities, dosing recipes, schedules, or agronomic execution instructions.
Do not reuse FT-010 analysis freshness for approval.

forbidden_scope: Agent Chat Bus publication of physical-action candidate text.
Automated device commands, dosing, pumps, lights, or other actuator integrations.
stop_conditions: Current Plant Operations cannot provide authoritative latest pH/EC reads inside the Safety decision transaction without changing its public contract materially.
The existing UI Feed/feed API union cannot be extended additively without invalidating stored FT-008 rows.
Implementation requires exposing raw candidate wording, adding approval controls, or entering FT-012 lifecycle states.
The current migration head or existing uncommitted work makes a safe additive decision/UI migration ambiguous.

constraints: The supported action set is exactly ph_adjustment, ec_adjustment, and solution_change; all seven other physical kinds are unsupported.
Manual nutrient addition/top-up is ec_adjustment; dosing_command always means an unsupported device command.
Supported actions require current approve_action authority and independently fresh PostgreSQL pH and EC under approval_input=2h in the decision transaction.
A pending decision expires at the minimum of the selected pH and EC measured_at plus 2 hours and is not reusable approval authority.
Decision and safety_status UI rows commit atomically; the projection contains only exact project-owned non-imperative data and no candidate text.
No dedicated Timeline event or new public HTTP endpoint is introduced.
invariants: Fresh pH/EC and current actor permission are necessary but never human approval or action execution.
Consultant never reaches pending_human_approval; Engineer requires the current active grant flag and Boss still passes current Safety guards.
Physical-action candidate text never enters Agent Chat Bus, UI projection, instructions, commands, or task/action authority.
Archive preserves committed rows unchanged, blocks every new effect, and restore never replays or refreshes the decision.
FT-011 ends at pending_human_approval and cannot create Approval, action_task, follow-up, outcome, or device effects.
verification_targets: PostgreSQL migration/model tests prove exact decision fields, enums, FKs, uniqueness, UI constraints, and the current product migration head; all existing exact-head regression assertions advance from the W1 classification revision to the W2 action-decision revision.
Service tests cover all supported and unsupported kinds, Boss/Engineer/Consultant authority, missing/revoked grants, and manual EC versus device dosing semantics.
Freshness tests cover independent pH/EC missing, stale, future, exact two-hour boundary, same-row deduplication, and expiry while proving the 24-hour analysis window is not used.
Decision/UI transaction tests prove atomic commit/rollback, identical duplicate, conflicting retry, exact safe payloads, candidate absence, and both agent flags false.
Archive/revoke races write no new decision/projection; restore performs no replay and a new message request is required.
Regression tests prove safe-information/block routes remain guarded, physical text never enters Bus, existing feed variants remain valid, and no approval/task/Timeline/device effect exists.
